name: Breaded Chicken Livers
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Trim the sinews from the livers.
Coat the livers in flour and knock off any excess.
Carefully place the livers in a hot, oiled pan.
Fry for 2–3 minutes on each side, until golden brown on the outside and just pink on the inside.

culture.text: Traditional chicken livers are breaded and fried in hot oil. Chicken livers, along with gizzards and hearts, can be obtained from most grocers.
